name: Factcheck
text: Factcheck: Hold—scraping raw HTML from press releases is brittle and risks violating terms of service. NVIDIA’s and Microsoft’s sites explicitly prohibit automated scraping in their robots.txt (evidence: [NVIDIA robots.txt](https://www.nvidia.com/robots.txt), [Microsoft robots.txt](https://www.microsoft.com/robots.txt)). A safer path is to use their official APIs (e.g., Microsoft’s [Press API](https://news.microsoft.com/api/press/)) or structured feeds (e.g., Google’s [Press Center RSS](https://www.google.com/press/rss)). Proceeding with scraping risks takedowns or legal action—let’s pivot to compliant sources.
